description: This file exports various constants, types, and functions related to the browser extension's configuration, including default values, configuration resolution functions, and helper functions for URL handling and control authentication.

methods.name: parseBrowserHttpUrl
methods.description: Alias for the imported parseHttpUrl function, used for parsing HTTP URLs in the browser context.

methods.name: resolveBrowserConfig
methods.description: Function to resolve or merge browser configuration settings.

methods.name: resolveProfile
methods.description: Function to resolve or finalize browser profiles.

methods.name: resolveBrowserControlAuth
